label: About
title: About A Reflection Out of Place
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1 recent saved-signal files and 1 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @sinnoh_CEO: Pokemon collage meme. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A Reflection Out of Place: Landscape photomontage: two unequal collage islands across quiet gray-blue space. A large detached black-rimmed mirror holds looping hair, cheek, suited shoulder and a glossy red cartoon-car sliver. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Visible mirror glass containing hair, cheek, suit and red cartoon-car fragments and Black-rimmed mirror glass holding hair, cheek, suit and a red cartoon-car sliver.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
